lines.directed: Conversely, the highest purification is not dependent upon the physical cleanliness of the body.
It’s the recognition of one’s true nature.
A Sanskrit textual witness also preserves a further closing stanza in a Middle Indo-Aryan vernacular form, beginning:

Its message again identifies true bathing with immersion in supreme bliss and the recognition of the highest Self. The stanza is absent from the GRETIL transcription and from the Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism edition, so I’m distinguishing it from the closing Sanskrit verse rather than silently combining the witnesses. १२
And now let’s finish in our own words.
